maxParticipants.name: Most players in a call
maxParticipants.hint: Every player's browser sends their camera to each of the others, so calls get heavy past a few players. GMs can always join; another player past this number is told the call is full.

stunServers.name: STUN servers
stunServers.hint: Help players' browsers find a way to each other through their routers. Used only when Foundry's A/V settings name no relay server of your own. Separate several with commas; leave empty for players on the same network.

relayOnly.name: Send everything through the relay server
relayOnly.hint: Only with a relay (TURN) server in Foundry's A/V settings: players then never see each other's IP addresses, at the cost of the relay's bandwidth.
